title: 2.8.2.7-dev commit 8efa66f23, Frozen screen and error message when activating a new eros POD
symptom: When activating a new Eros Pod, the screen freezes and an error message 'Close APP' or 'Wait' appears. Confirming with Wait allows activation to continue, but the freeze is problematic. The issue occurs during Pod activation, not deactivation.
cause: There is a general issue with Eros where long running interactions (e.g. with the pump) freeze the user interface.
fix: The issue was fixed in a later version; users report that after updating to AAPS 2.8.2.10-dev Build: 54b8d0613, the frozen screen no longer occurs.
evidence_quote: There is a general issue with Eros, where long running interactions (e.g. with the pump) freeze the user interface.
